upstream.description: Build an agentic RAG app from scratch by collaborating with Claude Code. 8-module course covering hybrid search, reranking, text-to-SQL, subagents, and more. React + FastAPI + Supabase.

classification.analysis: This is a companion repo and starter scaffold for an 8-module video course that teaches building an agentic RAG application from scratch by pair-programming with Claude Code. It covers chunking, hybrid search, reranking, text-to-SQL, and subagent patterns on a React + FastAPI + Supabase (pgvector) stack, and ships with a PRD, progress tracker, and Claude Code slash commands (/onboard, /build) rather than a finished app. Aimed at non-coders or junior builders who want a guided, AI-assisted path to a production-style RAG system.

use_cases.title: Follow a guided course to build an agentic RAG app by directing Claude Code
Learn hybrid search, reranking, and text-to-SQL patterns for a RAG pipeline
Use as a starter template with Claude Code slash commands for a Supabase-backed RAG app
